notes.title: Studio closure
notes.content: [p]Good day all, I'm sorry to say that NoTime Studios will be shutting down indefinitely. As a resultant we must retire our games. This means that they will no longer be available for purchase and the storefront will be removed from the Steam.[/p][p]It has been a privilege to make games for all of you. [/p][p]Barry and I (Brayden) will still be kickin' around and making games in some form but this chapter has sadly come to an end. [/p]

notes.title: Permanent Price Drop
notes.content:
Artillery Globe is dropping its price on Steam forever! This is not a sale! This is a price change to go along with our last update! 

If you ever wanted to check out Artillery Globe now would be the time!

A bunch of bug fixes and a updated control scheme for improved gameplay.

notes.title: Artillery Globe Update
notes.content:
* Slow down update to make the frame-rate smoother.
* Bug fix for the unit selection.
* Controls tuning - Made it so CTRL also multi-selects units.
* Ui Updates in the main menu.
* Ui Bug fixed in the settings menu.

notes.title: The new release date will be February 15th, 2019.
notes.content:
Dear all,

Thank you for your support. We regret to announce that Artillery Globe will be delayed. There was a licensing issue involved with our music provider that prevents the game from being released. Previously we have delayed the release date for 3 days from December 14th to 17th in hope to resolve this legal issue, but as the situation become clear that we will need more time to settle this matter.

We have no choice but to declare the postponement for the project. The team is currently working hard to resolve this issue in order to allow everyone to enjoy Artillery Globe as soon as possible.

The new release date will be February 15th, 2019. 

Thank you again for your support to our game and apologize for the delay.


NoTime Studios
